name: wh-frontier-task-suite
description: Create three Frontier-Bench tasks and carry them through pre-review hardening, exhaustive independent audit, repair, re-review, and immutable release.

interface.shortDescription: Create, harden, review, repair, and release three tasks.
interface.longDescription: A coordinated Codex workflow with seven bundled Frontier-Bench references. It spawns isolated author, pre-review hardener, reviewer, repair, re-review, and release agents; enforces exhaustive contract, input/domain, verifier, and runtime gates; repairs until PASS by default; and publishes only an immutable submission that matches a fresh passing review.
defaultPrompt: Run the complete multi-agent Frontier-Bench pipeline from authoring and hardening through immutable release.
Create three original Frontier-Bench tasks from one supported reference.
Independently audit or repair a three-task Frontier-Bench submission.
